Priya S: Heads-up 10: DevStream refapp launch week. Need: short launch post, 1-paragraph benchmark narrative, a 15-min webinar outline, and inbound lead routing + UTMs. Who volunteers?
Jules K: Ill draft the launch post + social snippets. Can someone give the single metric we want to lead with?
Marco (Bench): Latency P50 and cost per 1k tokens for the quantized v2 model. I can produce numbers by Tue morning.
Eve (DevRel): Ill do the quickstart tutorial + demo script. Live demo should be 6-8 minutes. Keep local setup to 3 steps.
Riley P: I can map inbound routing and set up the gated-download form. Suggest funnel: downloads -> devrel, webinar signups -> marketing, enterprise interest -> sales.
Priya S: Nice. Tone = "developer-first, production-ready". Lead metric idea: "<40ms P50 on dedicated" if Marco can back it.
Marco (Bench): Ill confirm. Quick note: include a small note about batching effects. Single request vs batch will show ~2x cost delta on some prompts.
Jules K: For social, short hooks: "Ship inference that scales" and "Refapp + benchmark = real results". Draft by Mon EOD.
Eve (DevRel): For the tutorial prompts, can we use a 8-prompt set that covers short/long/interactive? Marco: can you share that?
Marco (Bench): Yep. Will export and mark which prompts highlight latency improvements.
Riley P: Proposed routing table:
```
- downloads@redwood.com -> devrel@intercom (tag: refapp)
- webinar-signups@redwood.com -> marketing@zendesk (tag: devstream)
- enterprise@redwood.com -> sales@sf (priority: high)
```
Add UTM: utm_campaign=devstream_refapp, utm_source=community, utm_medium=post.
Priya S: Add form fields: name, email, company size, infra preference (hosted/dedicated/private). Put a hidden field "attended_webinar" default false.
Riley P: Will implement. Also suggest auto-tagging leads with prompt interest (in-product checkbox) so devrel can prioritize follow-ups.
Eve (DevRel): For the webinar outline: 1) 5-min intro (why inference ops matter), 2) 8-min demo, 3) 5-min bench walk-through, 4) 10-min Q&A. Can we trim to 30 if needed?
Priya S: Good. Keep Q&A flexible. Also we should prepare 3 canned answers for common infra questions (latency, cost, private deploy).
Jules K: Any quick examples for the launch post? Ill keep it short: intro line, 2 bullets (what the refapp demos, benchmark highlight), CTA to download + webinar signup.
Marco (Bench): ETA for bench results: Tue 10:00 PT. Ill attach a one-paragraph narrative: key signal, what we measured, why it matters.
Riley P: OpsBot: any conflicts with email sends Wed?
OpsBot: No conflicts detected for 2026-05-06. Recommended send window: 10am PT.
Priya S: OK, timeline recap:
- Jules: launch post + social by Mon EOD
- Marco: bench numbers + narrative by Tue 10am
- Eve: tutorial + demo script by Tue noon
- Riley: inbound routing & form + UTMs by Tue EOD
- Everyone: dress rehearsal Wed 1pm PT (30m).
Eve (DevRel): RSVP'd
Jules K: RSVP'd
Marco (Bench): RSVP'd
Riley P: RSVP'd
Priya S: Calendar invite sent. Ping me if you need different times. :calendar:
